normalized.description: Validate and auto-repair YAML frontmatter on brain pages. Catches malformed pages before they enter the brain (missing closing ---, nested quotes, slug mismatches, null bytes, empty frontmatter, YAML parse failures), explains files sync holds instead of importing, and drives the previewed `gbrain repair frontmatter` fix. Wraps the `gbrain frontmatter` CLI for agent-driven workflows.
normalized.name: frontmatter-guard
